body: The BRIDGE-AI Kenya team participated in a practical activity focused on hygiene, biosecurity and contamination prevention in mushroom production. Participants examined key areas where contamination can occur, including substrate preparation, handling of mushroom bags, incubation areas and growing rooms. The session emphasized proper cleaning, careful handling of materials, controlled movement within growing areas and early identification of abnormal growth.
location: JKUAT Smart Farm Zone, Juja, Kenya
summary: A practical session focused on identifying contamination risks and improving hygiene practices throughout the mushroom production process.
title: Mushroom Farm Hygiene and Contamination Prevention Activity
